column1: # The on-screen gamepad's default layout (dm/android/overlay_layout.h draws and hit-tests it). A game profile's android.tsv moves single controls with `overlay <name> <x> <y> [<r>]`;
# dm/android/tools/android_profile.py compiles the result into android_profile.h (DM_AOV_TABLE). Columns, separated by tabs:
#   name     what android.tsv calls the control
#   kind     stick_l, stick_r, button, dpad, menu (the menu button: pauses the game and opens the settings; always shown)
#   x, y     the centre, as fractions of the window's width and height
#   r        the radius, as a fraction of the window's height (round controls stay round on any aspect)
#   button   the DM_BTN_* bit a button sends, - for the others
#   label    the text drawn on a button, ~ for none
